# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 5 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** Praise to God the Righteous Provider

---

**5:1** O LORD God, I will praise your name with joy,
among those who know your righteous judgments.

**5:2** For you are good and merciful, the hope of the poor;
for who is like you, O God?

**5:3** I will praise your name among those who love you;
for you are good and full of mercy toward Israel.

**5:4** Blessed are those born in those days
to see the good things of Israel when God gathers the tribes.

**5:5** May God purify Israel for the day of mercy and blessing,
for the day of election when he brings back his anointed.

**5:6** Blessed are those who will live in those days
to see the good things of the LORD that he will do for the coming generation,

**5:7** under the discipline of the LORD's anointed,
in the fear of his God, in wisdom and righteousness and strength:

**5:8** that he may direct every person in works of righteousness by the fear of God,
establishing them all before the LORD as a good generation.

**5:9** Blessed are those born in those days
to see the good things of the LORD for the generation to come.

**5:10** May the mercy of the LORD be upon Israel forever and ever.

**5:11** For you, O God, are our king forever and ever;
in you, O God, shall our soul glory.

**5:12** How brief is the span of a man's life upon the earth;
as long as his days are, so long is his hope.

**5:13** But we hope in God our savior;
for the power of our God endures forever in mercy,
and the kingdom of our God rules forever over the nations in judgment.

**5:14** You, O LORD, chose Abraham above all the nations
and established your covenant with him and his seed forever.

**5:15** And you did not abandon us;
you gathered our scattered people of Israel from among the strangers.

**5:16** Great and holy is the LORD our God;
the strength of our God is in Jerusalem forever.

**5:17** And the mercy of the LORD is over the houses of Israel
forever and ever.

**5:18** For the LORD spares his faithful ones;
he wipes away their errors through his discipline.

**5:19** For the life of the righteous endures forever;
but sinners shall be taken away to destruction and their memory found no more.

---

*SOPHIA notes: Consensus rendering integrating EMET, LOGOS, and PNEUMA.*
